dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable selectors and the help example are present, but neither selector mutual exclusion nor formatted-output conflicts are enforced.
evidence: product.diff: flags append ordered fieldSelection entries
product.diff: adds repeated --field example
product.diff: registers flags but contains no Cobra conflict declaration; exporter still writes formatted output

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Case-insensitive resolution, canonical headers, and candidate-bearing unknown-field errors are present. Ambiguity is detected, but its candidate-ID order is inherited unsorted from the returned connection.
evidence: baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ResolveFieldByName uses strings.EqualFold
product.diff: headers use field.Name()
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: unknown-name/ID candidates are sorted
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ambiguous IDs are appended without sorting

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The normal path resolves the definitions returned by ProjectItems, but it never retrieves subsequent field-definition pages when selections are requested.
evidence: product.diff: resolves only project.Fields.Nodes after ProjectItems
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go: ProjectItems requests firstFields as LimitMax and paginates only items
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go: ProjectFields contains pagination support but is not called by the candidate path

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All specified scalar, structured, and multi-value variants have explicit rendering, with empty fallback; CR/LF normalization is absent.
evidence: product.diff: FieldValueNodes.DisplayValue handles date, iteration, number, select, text, milestone, labels, PRs, repository, users, and reviewers
product.diff: default DisplayValue return is empty
product.diff: no carriage-return/newline normalization before table output
tests.log: go test ./pkg/cmd/project/item-list ./pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries exited 0

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Resolved fields add headers in selection order, and values are found by field node ID with an empty fallback, preserving row alignment.
evidence: product.diff: printResults appends one header and one cell per selected field
product.diff: fieldValue compares value.ID() to field.ID() and returns empty when absent
tests.log: focused package test command exited 0

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Lookup errors occur before table rendering and the change uses existing query types, but invalid selector combinations and selector-plus-exporter usage are accepted instead of failing clearly.
evidence: product.diff: resolveSelectedFields returns before exporter/table output
product.diff: runList retains the existing exporter path after resolution
product.diff: no validation for combined selector forms or exporter conflict

criticalGaps: --field and --field-id can be combined, and either can be combined with formatted/JSON output without the required clear failure.
Requested fields beyond the initial ProjectItems field-definition page are never fetched.
Rendered values are not normalized to remove carriage returns and replace newlines with spaces.
